value.rationale: The fixed-cycle-length unicyclic graphs have identical volume c sqrt(n) and isomorphic graphic matroids, but a strict and completely classified Euclidean area ordering is proved. The global minimizer among all rooted attachments is highly rigid; among leaf allocations the balanced placement is uniquely maximal when feasible, and the strong-concavity deficit explicitly controls every cyclic interval discrepancy. These are natural structural and quantitative geometric facts, not a mere finite census or restatement of the generic zonotope formula.
